# `candid track`

Application tracker.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid track [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `add` | Add an application to the tracker. |
| `list` | List tracked applications (default view: newest first, up to --limit). |
| `update` | Update an application's status or notes. |
| `remove` | Remove an application. |
| `stats` | Funnel stats and rates. |
| `search` | Free-text search over company/role/notes. |
| `export-csv` | Export the tracker to CSV. |


### `candid track add`

Add an application to the tracker.

```
usage: python -m candid track add [-h] --company COMPANY --role ROLE [--jd-link JD_LINK] [--status STATUS] [--notes NOTES]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--company` `COMPANY` | (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--jd-link` `JD_LINK` | - |
| `--status` `STATUS` | (default: saved) |
| `--notes` `NOTES` | - |


### `candid track list`

List tracked applications (default view: newest first, up to --limit).

```
usage: python -m candid track list [-h] [--status STATUS] [--company COMPANY] [--limit LIMIT] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--status` `STATUS` | - |
| `--company` `COMPANY` | - |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | Max rows in the default view (default: 25) (default: 25) |
| `--json` | Print the application list as JSON (for scripting) |


### `candid track update`

Update an application's status or notes.

```
usage: python -m candid track update [-h] [--status STATUS] [--notes NOTES] id
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | (required) |
| `--status` `STATUS` | - |
| `--notes` `NOTES` | - |


### `candid track remove`

Remove an application.

```
usage: python -m candid track remove [-h] id
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | (required) |


### `candid track stats`

Funnel stats and rates.

```
usage: python -m candid track stats [-h]
```

### `candid track search`

Free-text search over company/role/notes.

```
usage: python -m candid track search [-h] query
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `query` | Search text (matches company, role, notes) (required) |


### `candid track export-csv`

Export the tracker to CSV.

```
usage: python -m candid track export-csv [-h] dest
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `dest` | Destination CSV file path (required) |
